'''Admiral Thrawn Myo''' is a strategy article published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] under the handle Admiral Thrawn, titled ''Myo.....Not Just A Primitive Desert Dweller!!''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Myo.htm Myo.....Not Just A Primitive Desert Dweller!!], The Outer Rim (Admiral Thrawn). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142720/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Myo.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Myo.....Not Just A Primitive
Desert Dweller!!


Now, I read an article why Myo is a primitive desert dweller, but on the contrary,
he's an awsome card. His stats show he's got ok Power/Ability, yet he's got
great forfeit and destiny! The only downfall is his deploy cost. Yet that's
no reason, not to have him in your deck, and it's even better now, since there
are bouty hunters up the ying yang! If we just look at these aspects of him
he's not so bad. Oh, we can't stop there, with a bounty hunter he gets power
added to himself. Stick him somewhere you need forfiet from a battle and even
if you may loose that battle it's not really a loss, if you took out a character
along with him, except Myo goes to the used pile! Now through his game text
we can see that the four deploy is put to good use in this card. Myo can 'regenerate'
after being forfeited or hit in a battle. You can Deploy him again, and again,
and again and again, and again and again, and again! A couple of combo's are
Myo & Jabba's Sail Barge Or Myo and Scum and Villiany Or Myo & Jabba the Hutt
& Audience Chamber Or Myo & Veers & Blizzard Walkers! You'll Enjoy the results!!!!!


Admiral
Thrawn
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
